description: The website's category and search grid for an agent: products with the product price of their shown offer (`lowest_goods`, in the `deliver_to_country` currency; its shipping `lowest_shipping` and the total `lowest_total` beside it, with capture time and `price_status` verified | estimate | incomplete), number of shops, best shop and trust label. Give `query` (free text, every word must match; 8 to 14 digits are an EAN, matched exactly) and/or `category` (a slug from GET /api/v1/deals/categories, e.g. letni-pneumatiky, mobilni-telefony), or neither to browse the whole catalogue (the website's /produkty page), or `slugs` (product slugs) to compare named products side by side; then any filters: price_min/price_max, brand, shops, shop_country (e.g. DE for offers from Germany), in_stock, on_sale, free_shipping, min_shop_rating, min_product_rating, attr (key:value pairs); sort price (lowest product price first, the default), price_desc, total (lowest total with shipping, opt-in; or include_shipping=true), total_desc, discount, shops, popular, rating, score, name. Answers at most `limit` products (default 20) from `offset`; `total_matches` counts every match, and `facets: true` adds the brands, shops, price range and attribute values with counts over the whole filtered list. With `query`, `query_match` says how the list answers it (all = every word found; partial = some words were dropped or matched only by typo tolerance; fallback = no product has the words, the list is the closest category's; none = nothing matches) and every product carries `match` (exact | close = another variant | partial = the name lacks some query words, `match_note` names them | fallback = not a match); never present a partial or fallback product as the asked-for item. Next: find_best_price with a product name for the full card with every offer, or price_history with `slug`.

attr.description: Attribute filter as `key:value` pairs (comma-separated in a query string, or repeated). The same key twice means any of its values; different keys must all match. Keys and values are those of `facets.attributes` (stored attributes plus storage_gb, ram_gb, diagonal and tyre_size read from the name; in phones, laptops, TVs, washing machines and headphones also network, cpu, gpu, resolution, panel, refresh_hz, tv_os, load_kg, spin_rpm, energy_class, top_loading, washer_dryer, wireless, anc and gaming), e.g. attr=storage_gb:256 GB,storage_gb:512 GB,ram_gb:8 GB.

brand.description: Brand or brands, matched case-insensitively against the exact brand name. MCP: an array of names (each item is one whole name, commas kept, e.g. ["Euromedia Group, a.s.", "Grada"]). Query string: repeat the parameter for exact names (`brand=Euromedia Group, a.s.&brand=Grada`; each value is one whole name, commas kept), or give one comma-separated value (`brand=Apple,Samsung`) where a comma inside a name is written `\,` and a backslash `\\` (`brand=Euromedia Group\, a.s.,Grada`). A single comma-separated value also matches as one whole name, so `brand=Euromedia Group, a.s.` finds that brand (and any brand named exactly `Euromedia Group` or `a.s.`).

category.description: Category slug (leaf, main category or group).

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

facet_attributes.description: false = facets without `attributes` (the whole catalogue without a category has about 1 800 attribute keys; the website's /produkty asks without them).

facets.description: true = also answer `facets` over the WHOLE filtered list, not just this page: brands, shops and shop countries with counts, the price range (min/max total), in_stock/on_sale/free_shipping counts and attribute values with counts. Each facet is counted over the products that pass every other filter, so the counts say what picking that value would give. With `facets` (or `attr`) every product's `attributes` also carries the derived keys (storage_gb, ram_gb, diagonal, tyre_size, and the top categories' parameters read from the name). `facets.categories` counts the leaf categories of the filtered list, `facets.price_p99` is the total 99 % of products stay under (a slider's upper end), `facets.price_p05` the total 95 % of products are at or above (a robust lower end; one wrong 0 price does not move it).

free_shipping.description: Only products with free delivery at the shown offer.

in_stock.description: Only products whose shown offer is in stock.

include_shipping.description: Order by the total with shipping to `deliver_to_country` instead of the product price (sort=total). Default false.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

min_product_rating.description: Lowest rating of the product itself, 0..1: the shops' own customer reviews and forDeal reviews (0.9 = 90 %).

min_shop_rating.description: Lowest rating of the shown shop, 0..1 (0.9 = 90 % / 4.5 stars).

offset.description: Rows to skip before `limit` (paging). `total` in the answer is the number of matching products before offset and limit, so offset + count < total means there is another page.

on_sale.description: Only products with a shop discount or a measured drop.

price_max.description: Highest product price in the deliver-to currency (shipping not counted).

price_min.description: Lowest product price in the deliver-to currency (the shown offer's goods price, shipping not counted).

q.description: Short name of `query` (the same search; `query` wins when both are given).

query.description: Free text; every word must appear in the product name. 8 to 14 digits are an EAN (exact match on the product's or an offer's barcode).

shop_country.description: Country codes of the shops (e.g. DE to see offers from Germany).

shops.description: Shop slugs (e.g. datart-cz); a product passes when one of them prices it.

slugs.description: Product slugs (comma-separated or an array): only these products, every filter still applies. The website's product comparison (/produkty/porovnat?p=a,b,c) compares up to 4.

sort.description: relevance = best match first (the default with `query`; the answer card names the first row), price = lowest product price first (the default without `query`; shipping is shown per product, not counted), price_desc = most expensive product price, total = lowest total with shipping first (opt-in, the same as include_shipping=true), total_desc = highest total with shipping, discount = biggest discount, shops = most shops, popular = most searched and clicked, rating = best rated product (shops' and forDeal reviews, fewer reviews count less), score = forDeal score 0–100 (popularity, shops, price vs. 30 days, shop rating, product rating; each product carries `score.parts`), goods = older name of price, name = alphabetical.

name: search_products
title: Search and filter compared products
